select t1.id, t1.tutor_id, t1.title, c.id as classroom_id, c.name as classroom_name, c.classroom_number, t1.transportation_fee,
t2.id as lesson_id, t2.template_id as lesson_template_id, t2.start_time as lesson_start_time, t2.end_time as lesson_end_time, t2.break_minutes as lesson_break_minutes, t2.period_code_m as lesson_period_code_m, t2.period_code_k as lesson_period_code_k, t2.period_code_s as lesson_period_code_s, t2.period_code_a as lesson_period_code_a, t2.period_code_b as lesson_period_code_b, t2.period_code_c as lesson_period_code_c, t2.period_code_d as lesson_period_code_d,
t3.id as office_id, t3.template_id as office_template_id, t3.start_time as office_start_time, t3.end_time as office_end_time,
t4.id as other_id, t4.template_id as other_template_id, t4.start_time as other_start_time, t4.end_time as other_end_time, t4.break_minutes as other_break_minutes, t4.description as other_description from templates as t1 left join lesson_template_details as t2 on t1.id = t2.template_id left join office_template_details as t3 on t1.id = t3.template_id left join other_template_details as t4 on t1.id = t4.template_id left join classrooms as c on t1.classroom_id = c.id where t1.tutor_id = #{tutorId}
